glossary.definition: Two RFC 8693 exchanges build act={specialist, act:{generalist}}: the specialist acts via the generalist, acting for the same user. Scope narrows at each hop — least privilege across agent hops, the full chain visible in the token.

Two things are called A2A: the Linux Foundation agent protocol (Agent Card, JSON-RPC, a real 401 without the bearer) and the identity chain. Authorization keys on WHO is acting — an unregistered specialist identity is denied.

sources.title: A2A protocol: agent discovery (Agent Card)
sources.use: The well-known Agent Card the lab serves at /api/a2a/agent-card.

sources.title: RFC 8693: OAuth 2.0 Token Exchange
sources.use: The act claim and the two exchanges that build the nested chain.

cards.label: Scenario 1: UC2: generalist hands off — nested act chain permits
cards.description: Two exchanges build act={specialist, act:{generalist}} acting for the same user. The chain is valid and the specialist is registered: PERMIT with the full chain in the token.

cards.label: Scenario 2: UC2.6: unregistered specialist — PERMIT_THEN_DENY
cards.description: Same user, same delegation shape — but "rogue-specialist" is not in the Agent Card registry. Authorization keys on WHO is acting.

cards.label: Scenario 3: SCOPE: the handoff did not grant the scope
cards.description: Exchange #2 narrows scope: the specialist may hold at most what the generalist had. An ungranted scope is narrowed away and the gateway denies.

cards.label: Scenario 4: NOT A HANDOFF: a plain act={agent} token is refused
cards.description: A2A calls require the NESTED chain. A depth-1 act={agent} token is the generalist acting alone — no handoff to validate.

cards.label: Scenario 5: UC2.7: the Agent Card is served; no bearer is a real 401
cards.description: The protocol side of A2A: the well-known Agent Card, and a 401 before anything else when the bearer is missing. Identity and protocol, side by side.

cards.label: Flip the Agent Card registry live
cards.description: Register or revoke a specialist live; the SAME handoff flips on the next run — authorization keys on WHO is acting.

cards.label: Doctor and health
cards.description: Preflight checks and the demo-health/1 endpoint.
